# fundament_organization_members (Data Source)

Fetches the list of members for the current organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fundament_organization_members" "all" {}

output "member_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.fundament_organization_members.all.members : m.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `members` (Attributes List) List of organization members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) The timestamp when the member was created.
- `email` (String) The email address of the member.
- `external_id` (String) The external identity provider ID.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the member.
- `name` (String) The display name of the member.
- `permission` (String) The permission of the member.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID (users.id) of the member.
